newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Croatia Airlines to start ex-Netherlands trucking.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Airlines to start ex-Netherlands trucking.

text.p: Croatia Airlines will start a weekly trucking service between Amsterdam Schiphol and Zagreb in the beginning of July.
Carlo de Haas, cargo spokesman for Air Support, Croatia Airlines Dutch general sales agent, said the airline operates either Boeing 737-200 aircraft or A320s on its daily Zagreb-Amsterdam route.
However, the route is so busy with tourist traffic it is often difficult to get enough cargo space, especially for out-size cargo, he said.
By truck the journey will take between 24-30 hours and it will have a temperature control facility. Croatia Airlines Belgian cargo, as well as the Dutch, will also be sharing the trucking service.
Departures are initially scheduled for each Tuesday evening and a weekend departure may eventually be included, said De Haas.
Cargo carried ships'spares, machinery, computer mainframes and electronic equipment, he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
